summary_en: The company raised its interim dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027 by 7 yen to 17 yen per share, increasing the full-year dividend forecast from 31 yen to 38 yen per share, based on comprehensive review of business outlook, operating environment, retained earnings, and capital policy.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Interim Dividend Forecast (Increase)
translation_en_brief: On September 24, 2026, TANAKA CO., LTD. announced a revision to its interim dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company increased its interim dividend per share from the previously forecasted 10 yen to 17 yen, representing a 7 yen increase. Consequently, the full-year dividend forecast was raised from 31 yen per share to 38 yen per share, with the year-end dividend remaining at 21 yen per share. This revision was made based on a comprehensive review of the company's business outlook, operating environment, internal retained earnings, and capital policy. The board of directors approved this modification on the date of the announcement as part of the company's core management policy to establish a stable operational foundation while delivering returns to shareholders.
